1.consolidated_definition: alim. Bizcochito individual en forma de taza. Anglicismo crudo, usual. Niños de hasta 15 años recibirán una tarjeta de membresía y un delicioso cupcake. Cada vez que visiten Amigo y presenten su tarjeta del Club de Amiguitos, recibirán un cupcake gratis (Supermercados Amigo, 23-06-05)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Individual biscuit in the shape of a cup. Raw Anglicism, commonly used. Children up to 15 years old will receive a membership card and a delicious cupcake. Each time they visit Amigo and present their Little Friends Club card, they will receive a free cupcake (Amigo Supermarkets, 23-06-05)
